## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Runtime`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `runtime-configurations`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Runtime**.

## Step 2: Configure an integration

1. <!-- manual: Open your integration from the project home. -->
2. <!-- manual: On the integration overview page, locate the environment you want to configure. -->
3. Select **Configure** on that environment card.
4. <!-- manual: Add the configurable values as needed. -->
5. Select **Update** to apply the changes.

## Step 3: Secrets

1. <!-- manual: Open your integration and click Configure for the target environment. -->
2. <!-- manual: Enter the secret value. -->
3. <!-- manual: Next to the configurable field you want to protect, click the padlock icon. -->
4. Select **Update**.

## Step 4: Create a configuration group

1. <!-- manual: In the top navigation, click your organization name to switch to the organization level. -->
2. <!-- manual: In the left navigation, go to Admin › Config Groups. -->
3. Select **Create** to create a configuration group.
4. <!-- manual: Fill in the following fields: -->
5. <!-- manual: Add the fields for the group. For each field, provide: -->
6. After adding all fields, assign values to each field.
7. Select **Create** to save the configuration group.

## Step 5: Edit a configuration group

1. <!-- manual: On the Config Groups page, click the configuration group you want to edit. -->
2. <!-- manual: If you only want to update the values of the fields, click the edit icon on the value card. -->
3. <!-- manual: To edit the fields, click Edit Configuration Group. -->
4. <!-- manual: Update the fields, their types and values as needed. -->
5. Select **Update** to save the changes.

## Step 6: Link a configuration group to an integration

1. <!-- manual: Open your integration and click Configure for the target environment. -->
2. <!-- manual: Enable the Allow Linking Configuration Groups toggle. A link icon appears next to each configurable field. -->
3. <!-- manual: Click the link icon next to a configurable field. -->
4. <!-- manual: Select the configuration group and the specific field within the group that maps to this configurable. -->
5. <!-- manual: Repeat for each configurable you want to link. -->
6. Select **Update**.
